LanguageData.RP_RiotReviewAnswers:
Restrict the wing for 1, 2 or 3 days - the yard is off and lockup comes early each day, and the wing riots less while it lasts. Each day served holds it down more ({6} suppression a day, counted as each day ends, less for a part of one), and a wing held down past the line is shut out of its programs. The tension it held down lands when it ends ({0} a day on each inmate), and the inspector counts the days. Lifting the yard order or the early lockup ends it.
Ship the ringleader out - {1}, a little reputation and the payment they bring; their gang loses its leader. Only if the ringleader was seen.
Charge what was seen - the inmates named above go on the adjudication sheet as cases, except anyone sanctioned or put on the sheet for this riot already (a riot is heard all over the prison, and the sanction policy deals with the rioters as it starts).
Make restitution - the {2} bill comes out of the named inmates' cash, as far as it goes.
Meet the grievance - a promise to fix their {3} within {4} hours, as a negotiation makes one.
Amnesty - tension down on the wing and a little reputation lost, and for {5} days the wing riots more readily. It is the only answer, and the sanctions given as the riot started stand.
